title: Dashboard exception: daisyUI kwg dark theme

theme.name: kwg
theme.purpose: Only enabled daisyUI theme; built-in themes are disabled. Neutral dark base, amber primary for goal progress and primary actions.

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: Editor and dialog entry; reduced motion disables transitions and animations.

breakpoints.name: drawer
breakpoints.purpose: Below lg the rail becomes a daisyUI drawer opened by Pages.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: One amber primary action per view; 44 px from --size-field.

components.name: Text field
components.description: Label above; daisyUI input with semantic border and muted placeholder.

components.name: Sidebar link
components.description: daisyUI menu item; menu-active plus aria-current marks the page.

components.name: Goal stat
components.description: Goal progress uses stats; status always has text, never color alone.

components.name: Status badge
components.description: Soft badges for connection and pipeline states.
